Texture-space coordinates, not a world-space or projected pixel position.

Channels.description: Actual active and inactive source channels. Quaternion order is W/X/Y/Z.

axis_angle.description: Angle in radians, then X/Y/Z axis. The stored axis need not be unit.

order.description: Authored scene order. New objects absent from it follow in ID order.

quaternion_wxyz.description: Actual raw channels in W/X/Y/Z order, including inactive values.

Mode.description: Authored representation, independent of its evaluated physical pose.

rotation.description: Actual authored mode. Coordinates use metres and a right-handed Z-up space.

uv_layers.description: One value for each corner, in the same order as vertices.
